exercise_library.name: Bench press
exercise_library.instructions: Feet planted, shoulder blades pulled back. Lower the bar under control to mid-chest, press up and slightly back. Use a spotter or safety arms.

exercise_library.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercise_library.instructions: Bench at 30–45°. Lower dumbbells to upper chest with elbows ~45° from torso, press up without clashing.

exercise_library.name: Decline press
exercise_library.instructions: Secure legs, lower to lower chest, press to lockout under control.

exercise_library.name: Chest press machine
exercise_library.instructions: Set handles at mid-chest height. Press out smoothly, return slowly without letting the stack touch down.

exercise_library.name: Cable fly
exercise_library.instructions: Slight elbow bend held constant. Bring hands together in an arc, squeeze, return with control.

exercise_library.name: Pec deck
exercise_library.instructions: Elbows slightly below shoulders. Bring pads together, pause, return slowly.

exercise_library.name: Lat pulldown
exercise_library.instructions: Chest up, pull bar to upper chest by driving elbows down. Avoid leaning far back.

exercise_library.name: Seated cable row
exercise_library.instructions: Neutral spine. Pull handle to lower ribs, squeeze shoulder blades, extend arms fully under control.

exercise_library.name: Dumbbell row
exercise_library.instructions: One hand and knee on bench, flat back. Row the dumbbell toward the hip.

exercise_library.name: Chest-supported row
exercise_library.instructions: Chest on pad, row elbows back, avoid lifting chest off the pad.

exercise_library.name: Face pull
exercise_library.instructions: Rope at face height. Pull toward the face with elbows high, externally rotate at the end.

exercise_library.name: Assisted pull-up
exercise_library.instructions: Log the assistance amount in the weight field (lower = harder). Assistance is not counted as lifting volume.

exercise_library.name: Shoulder press
exercise_library.instructions: Brace core, press overhead without arching the lower back. Lower to ear level.

exercise_library.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercise_library.instructions: Slight elbow bend, raise to shoulder height leading with elbows. Control the descent.

exercise_library.name: Front raise
exercise_library.instructions: Raise to shoulder height in front, no swinging.

exercise_library.name: Rear delt fly
exercise_library.instructions: Hinge forward or use machine; sweep arms out wide, squeeze rear delts.

exercise_library.name: Dumbbell curl
exercise_library.instructions: Elbows pinned to sides, curl without swinging, lower fully.

exercise_library.name: Hammer curl
exercise_library.instructions: Neutral grip (palms facing). Curl and lower under control.

exercise_library.name: Barbell curl
exercise_library.instructions: Shoulder-width grip, elbows fixed, avoid leaning back.

exercise_library.name: Preacher curl
exercise_library.instructions: Upper arm flat on pad. Lower until nearly straight, do not bounce.

exercise_library.name: Triceps pushdown
exercise_library.instructions: Elbows at sides, extend fully, return to ~90° under control.

exercise_library.name: Overhead extension
exercise_library.instructions: Elbows pointing up and close, lower behind head, extend fully.

exercise_library.name: Skull crushers
exercise_library.instructions: Lower toward forehead/behind head by bending elbows only. Start light.

exercise_library.name: Squats
exercise_library.instructions: Brace, sit down between hips to a depth you control with a neutral spine. Use safety pins.

exercise_library.name: Leg press
exercise_library.instructions: Feet shoulder-width. Lower until knees ~90° without the lower back lifting off the pad. Do not lock knees hard.

exercise_library.name: Leg curl
exercise_library.instructions: Pad above heels, curl fully, lower slowly.

exercise_library.name: Leg extension
exercise_library.instructions: Pad on lower shin, extend fully, pause, lower under control.

exercise_library.name: Romanian deadlift
exercise_library.instructions: Soft knees, hinge at hips keeping the bar close and back neutral. Stop when hamstrings limit range.

exercise_library.name: Hip thrust
exercise_library.instructions: Upper back on bench, drive through heels to full hip extension, chin tucked.

exercise_library.name: Calf raises
exercise_library.instructions: Full stretch at bottom, pause at the top.

exercise_library.name: Split squats
exercise_library.instructions: Log reps per leg. Torso tall, lower back knee toward the floor.

exercise_library.name: Plank
exercise_library.instructions: Forearms under shoulders, straight line head to heels, brace abs and glutes. Log seconds held.

exercise_library.name: Side plank
exercise_library.instructions: Elbow under shoulder, hips high. Log seconds per side.

exercise_library.name: Dead bug
exercise_library.instructions: Lower back pressed into floor, extend opposite arm and leg slowly. Log reps per side.

exercise_library.name: Cable crunch
exercise_library.instructions: Kneel, crunch by flexing the spine, not by pulling with arms.

exercise_library.name: Leg raises
exercise_library.instructions: Control the descent; keep lower back from arching.

exercise_library.name: Kettlebell swing
exercise_library.instructions: Hip hinge, snap hips forward, bell floats to chest height. Learn the hinge before going heavy.

exercise_library.name: Farmer's carry
exercise_library.instructions: Tall posture, walk with control. Log weight in each hand and seconds walked.

exercise_library.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercise_library.instructions: Half-kneeling, tuck pelvis and gently shift forward. Log seconds per side.

exercise_library.name: Thoracic rotation
exercise_library.instructions: Side-lying or quadruped, rotate upper back slowly. Log reps per side.

exercise_library.name: Cat-cow
exercise_library.instructions: Alternate spinal flexion and extension slowly with breathing.

workout_plans.name: Push A
workout_plans.notes: Start with weights you can control for the top of the rep range with good form. Leave 1–3 reps in reserve.

workout_plans.name: Pull A
workout_plans.notes: Focus on pulling with the back, not momentum.

workout_plans.name: Legs A
workout_plans.notes: Warm up thoroughly. Squat depth only as deep as you can control with a neutral spine.

workout_plans.name: Cardio & Mobility
workout_plans.notes: 30–45 minutes of low-to-moderate intensity cardio (walk, cycle, cross-trainer). Log it under Cardio & Steps. Then the mobility circuit below.

workout_plans.name: Upper Body B
workout_plans.notes: Machine-friendly upper day. Keep 1–3 reps in reserve.

workout_plans.name: Legs B & Conditioning
workout_plans.notes: Finish with conditioning only if recovered. Stop if anything hurts.

workout_plans.name: Rest
workout_plans.notes: Full rest. Easy walking is fine.

workout_plan_exercises.training_notes: Strict form; light weight is normal.
